D6Digital

Euclidean Rhythm

Four Euclidean rhythm generators

Four independent channels spread a number of hits as evenly as possible over a number of steps and output a gate on every hit.

  • Pattern length from 1 to 32 steps per channel
  • Hits, length and offset per channel
  • Shared clock and reset
Width10 HP · 50.6 mm
Height3 U · 128.5 mm
Jacks6
Knobs12
